description: Return desenmascara.me's existing assessment of a domain: the verdict, when it was reached, the recorded findings and a link to the published report. Reads stored data only — it starts no new analysis. A domain with no report returns status 'not_found', which says nothing about the site. desenmascara.me assesses whether a website domain is fraudulent, using evidence gathered at a point in time. It can and does decline to judge when the evidence is insufficient. It assesses domains, not URLs, and its assessment does not establish that a particular payment or action is safe.

domain.description: A hostname such as example.com or shop.example.com. Not a URL: paths and query strings are not assessed. Subdomains are significant and are not collapsed to the parent domain.
domain.title: Domain

language.description: Language for the explanation and findings.
